# superset_dataset_import (Resource)

Imports the datasets of an export bundle together with the databases they depend on, and imports them again whenever the bundle changes. Destroying the resource deletes the datasets only. When one export feeds several import resources, order them with `depends_on` (datasets, then charts, then dashboards): Superset refuses to delete a dataset that charts still use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The datasets of an export, with their columns and metrics kept in sync with the files.
resource "superset_dataset_import" "warehouse" {
  source       = "${path.module}/exports/warehouse"
  sync_columns = true
  sync_metrics = true

  database_passwords = {
    "databases/warehouse.yaml" = var.warehouse_password
  }
}

# The charts of the same export. The dependency orders creation and destruction: Superset
# refuses to delete a dataset that charts still use.
resource "superset_chart_import" "warehouse" {
  source     = "${path.module}/exports/warehouse"
  depends_on = [superset_dataset_import.warehouse]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `database_passwords` (Map of String, Sensitive) Passwords of the databases of the bundle, needed when a database is created by the import. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`, or by the file name alone, such as `warehouse.yaml`.
- `files` (Map of String) The files of the bundle, keyed by their path in the export layout, such as `dashboards/sales.yaml` or `databases/warehouse.yaml`, with their YAML content as values. The provider zips them with a `metadata.yaml` of the right type, as it does for a directory in `source`. Use it instead of `source` where the provider cannot read files, for example when it runs in a controller. Exactly one of `source` and `files` must be set.
- `overwrite` (Boolean) Whether objects that already exist in Superset are replaced. Without it, Superset refuses to import an object that exists. Defaults to `true`.
- `source` (String) Directory in the export layout of Superset (`dashboards/`, `charts/`, `datasets/`, `databases/`), or an export zip file. A directory is bundled by the provider with a `metadata.yaml` of the right type, so one export can feed every import resource. Exactly one of `source` and `files` must be set.
- `ssh_tunnel_passwords` (Map of String, Sensitive) Passwords of the SSH tunnels of the databases of the bundle. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`, or by the file name alone, such as `warehouse.yaml`.
- `ssh_tunnel_private_key_passwords` (Map of String, Sensitive) Passphrases of the private keys of the SSH tunnels of the databases of the bundle. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`, or by the file name alone, such as `warehouse.yaml`.
- `ssh_tunnel_private_keys` (Map of String, Sensitive) Private keys of the SSH tunnels of the databases of the bundle. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`, or by the file name alone, such as `warehouse.yaml`.
- `sync_columns` (Boolean) Whether the columns of datasets that already exist are replaced by the columns of the bundle. Defaults to `false`.
- `sync_metrics` (Boolean) Whether the metrics of datasets that already exist are replaced by the metrics of the bundle. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) Hash of the files of the bundle. A change of the files plans an import.
- `dataset_ids` (Map of Number) Identifiers of the imported datasets, keyed by the uuid of their export.
